d:
Luka Dončić is the 30-5-5 king! He finished with 32 points, 5 rebounds and 5 assists as the Lakers beat the Bucks, 123-112, for their seventh straight win.
It’s his ninth straight game with 30+ points, 5+ rebounds and 5+ assists, tying the NBA record shared by Dončić himself and Oscar Robertson. It’s the sixth such streak in NBA history, and Luka owns four of the six, with Robertson holding the other two.
Over the Lakers’ win streak, Luka is averaging 40.7 points, 7.7 assists, 8.2 rebounds and 2.8 steals per game, while L.A. is scoring 125.3 points and allowing 115 on average.
